articles.title: Tejas Networks selected for a 4G network expansion project in South Asia
articles.summary: Tejas Networks has secured a significant purchase order to supply its advanced 4G Radio Access Network (RAN) technology. This highlights the company's role in strengthening India's indigenous telecom infrastructure and digital connectivity. Such orders typically bolster national communication capabilities, showcasing advancements in crucial network technology.

articles.title: Space Power Electronics Market Size to Surpass $1804.16 Million by 2035 | Research by SNS Insider
articles.summary: The Space Power Electronics Market, critical for advanced space missions and satellite technology, was valued at approximately USD 372.14 million. An SNS Insider analysis projects its growth outlook, highlighting the escalating demand for efficient power solutions in spacecraft. Such advancements are crucial for enhancing national strategic space capabilities, telecommunications, and defence infrastructure.
